items.title: Zero unanswered calls during active lock decoding
items.metricLabel: First-ring call coverage during active field jobs
items.denominator: Observed across pilot field shifts with conditional call-forwarding enabled
items.quote: When your hands are on a pick and decoder in the dark, every vibration in your pocket is an impossible choice. With automated voice intake, the customer is calmed, the car details are checked, and the dispatch is waiting on your dashboard.

items.title: Structured vehicle data before arrival
items.quote: The biggest time-waster was driving 25 minutes only to discover the customer had an AKL situation on a high-security French vehicle with no pin code. The AI checks if keys are locked inside or completely lost before we leave the shop.

items.title: Exact GPS location instead of vague descriptions
items.quote: Motorists stranded on country roads or multi-storey car parks rarely know their exact address. Automated mobile location requests eliminate the 15-minute phone calls trying to find their vehicle.

items.title: Protecting family time without losing emergency income
items.quote: Weekend emergency calls are high margin, but 70% of night calls are price-checkers who hang up. The agent filters serious lockouts with confirmed payment intent from casual queries.

items.title: Sub-60s triage to roadside navigation
items.quote: Our customers are distressed drivers locked out in parking garages or highway stops. Cutting call handling down to under a minute allows our mobile van to roll immediately with verified vehicle year and transponder profile.
